restaurant_name: Pro Smile Dental Clinic โดย ท.พ.สมยศ
text:
Despite lowering the star rating repeatedly, there's still no improvement. At first, I secretly blamed the staff for their poor time management, but then I thought, shouldn't the staff just follow their employer's instructions? I once saw someone scolding staff for not having all the patients scheduled for appointments. I thought to myself, "Even with incomplete appointments, we still wait 2-3 hours!" And recently, all the good, skilled staff have left. Now the clinic is only open on Saturdays. Oh my god, I've spent so much money at this clinic. 1000 baht a month is no longer valid. They even split the scaling up and down, saying there was too much tartar to do in one go. I've never experienced this before. 1000 baht for the upper teeth scaling, and then another 1000 baht for the lower teeth scaling.
Unbelievable! Before, they called to schedule appointments and reminded me, which was great. Now, even after calling every day, they don't answer and their phones are even turned off.
The expenses are spiraling out of control.
The first day, I transferred a 300 baht deposit for the monthly plan.
The next day, a dental assessment was scheduled, which was free.😅
But the next appointments started. 4500 baht for the dental patch.
7-day appointment for the dental patch, 4500 baht. (This isn't metal braces.)
Checking the patch twice. I had an appointment to get upper braces for 4500 baht (only the front 6 teeth).
The following month, I had an appointment to get lower braces for 4500 baht (6 braces as well).
My friends asked if I got fashion braces, I laughed at myself.
I had another appointment the following month, and the staff told me to prepare 1000 baht. I went to the appointment, and the doctor added more braces – 4 on top and 2 on the bottom. I was secretly happy that I finally had them all.
When I went downstairs to make an appointment and pay, the staff said it was 4000 baht for today. I was shocked, so I asked the staff again. It turned out that I had to pay extra for the additional braces. That's when things started to spiral out of control. The next appointment was for lower braces, another 4500 baht, and then another 4500 baht for the lower braces themselves.
I almost fainted. So where did the 1000 baht a month go? Run away, everyone! I've already consulted with a new clinic. I wasted so much money and got nothing in return, and I wasted over 2 years. I've moved my case to a new clinic. This clinic is unbearable in every way. They're constantly postponing appointments, they're good at demanding money, and the clinic is only open one day a week.
From being pleased, now I feel like it's my karma. I must have gotten into debt and now I'm paying for my sins. I bow down in respect. Even driving past it now makes me scared. I don't dare drive past. I regret wasting so much money. It's truly karma. 😭😭😭

text: I'm very disappointed. Initially, the service was excellent and the advice was great. They called to confirm my appointment in advance, in case I forgot or had other commitments. Now, it's difficult to contact them. Their Facebook page says they're under maintenance, but the phone numbers are unreachable. I know they've changed their phone number, but some months the clinic is closed more often than it's open, and they don't call to inform me. Furthermore, I feel the charges are increasing. They're charging for the braces in a confusing way. Initially, I understood that the dentist might have used plates to attach the braces, resulting in incomplete braces, but I paid the full amount. Then, after the plates were removed and additional braces were added, they wanted to charge me again (but I refused, telling them I'd already paid in full). This is my honest review; I hope the clinic improves. However, I've already switched clinics.
